_instructions: Base features grouped by category. Each category maps to a page under Features & Payments. Adding a feature = adding one object to an items array — it will appear on the features page and anywhere that category is surfaced.

items.name: Table and floor management
items.body: Track seating, turns, and server sections from one screen.

items.name: Split checks and seat ordering
items.body: Split by seat, item, or percentage without restarting the ticket.

items.name: Course firing
items.body: Hold and fire courses so the kitchen sends food when the table is ready.

items.name: Tip handling
items.body: Tip pooling, tip sharing, and adjustments after close.

items.name: Kitchen display system
items.body: Orders route to the right station with timers and bump bars.

items.name: Customer-facing display
items.body: Shows the order as it rings, plus tip prompt and receipt options.

items.name: Printer routing
items.body: Send items to specific printers by category or station.

items.name: Real-time inventory
items.body: Counts move as items sell, with low-stock alerts.

items.name: Modifiers and combos
items.body: Nested modifiers, mix-and-match pricing, and bundle deals.

items.name: Purchase orders
items.body: Build POs, receive against them, and track vendor cost changes.

items.name: Age verification
items.body: ID scanning and prompts for restricted items.

items.name: Clock in and out
items.body: Time tracking on the POS with PIN or badge.

items.name: Scheduling
items.body: Build shifts and let staff see the schedule from their phone.

items.name: Permissions
items.body: Role-based access down to the individual function.

items.name: Labor reporting
items.body: Labor cost as a live percentage of sales.

items.name: Mobile analytics app
items.body: Sales, labor, and top items on your phone in real time.

items.name: Sales reporting
items.body: By daypart, category, employee, or location.

items.name: Multi-location rollup
items.body: Compare stores side by side on one dashboard.

items.name: Online ordering
items.body: Your own ordering page, orders land directly in the POS.

items.name: E-commerce buildout
items.body: A storefront tied to the same catalog and inventory.

items.name: Online invoicing
items.body: Send a payment link and get paid without the customer in front of you.

items.name: Accounting exports
items.body: Clean exports for your bookkeeper or accounting software.

items.name: DoorDash
items.body: Orders route into the POS with no tablet juggling.

items.name: Uber Eats
items.body: Menu and availability stay in sync with your catalog.

items.name: Grubhub
items.body: Consolidated ticket flow alongside dine-in orders.

items.name: One ticket queue
items.body: Delivery orders land beside dine-in and phone orders, so there is no separate tablet to watch.

items.name: Every payment type
items.body: EMV chip, tap, swipe, mobile wallets, and gift cards.

items.name: Next-day funding
items.body: Batches settle to your account the next business day.

items.name: Cash discount program
items.body: Run 0% processing with compliant signage and receipt handling.

items.name: PCI compliance support
items.body: We handle the paperwork so you don't get hit with non-compliance fees.

_note_on_images: Each feature page takes one hero image. Categories that share a page share the same path, so the file is uploaded once. Drop it at hero_image and the slot renders the photo.
_note_on_delivery: Delivery moved out of `integrations` into its own category so it generates /grub-hub-doordash-uber-eats. That slug was in the nav and the URL map from day one but nothing built it — it 404'd. It now has a page.
